brief: A round stone vault at the foot of a spiral stair; a small ink-dark spirit tangled in a long cord of tiny knotted letters, knots at every joint; a carved verse on the wall with no gaps between words; Dādī kneeling beside the spirit; Śuka on the carved ledge reading; at the top of the stair, a tall figure in a dark coat in silhouette.
notes: Painting reviewed against its exact source brief. Every visible text string compared with the recorded source text; reference font inspected when needed. This is direct visual review, not an OCR-service result.
